The '''Belgian Mathematical Society''' (abbreviated as '''BMS'''), founded in 1921 by [[Théophile de Donder]] at the [[Université libre de Bruxelles]],<ref>{{citation
 | last = | first = 
 | issue = 
 | mr = 
 | pages = 
 | title = BMS Statutes
 | url = https://www.dropbox.com/s/664so52cey840j9/Belgian%20Mathematical%20Society%20Statuts.pdf
 | volume = 
 | year = 2020}}.</ref> is the national mathematical society of [[Belgium]] and a member society of the [[European Mathematical Society]]. Its mission is to assemble all Belgian mathematicians and defend their interests. Foreign members are also welcome.<ref>{{citation
 | last = | first = 
 | issue = 
 | mr = 
 | pages = 
 | title = About the BMS
 | url = http://dwispc8.vub.ac.be/nieuwBMS/index.php?id=about-the-belgian-mathematical-society
 | volume = 
 | year = 2022}}.</ref> 

The society publishes the journal ''[[Bulletin of the Belgian Mathematical Society - Simon Stevin]]'' and distributes a newsletter to members, both at a rate of five issues per year.
